edges.reason: The acacia_wall_sign is mounted on a jungle plank structure inside the jungle zone; player must locate the jungle area first to find and mine it
The nether corner entrance is adjacent to the jungle zone; player must explore the jungle area to discover the path to the netherrack section
After mining debris in the nether corner, player returns to the station area and accesses the material chest containing the damaged iron sword and iron ingots needed for anvil repair
Repairing the sword at the anvil places the player at the station area where the crafting table is 2 blocks away; player has already opened the material chest containing acacia planks
After anvil repair, player is at the station area and has already accessed the material chest (for iron ingots) which also contains the 9 coal needed for coal_block crafting
The consumable chest at ~1,0,-5 is directly behind the brewing stand at ~1,0,-3; interacting with the stand leads player to notice and open the adjacent chest containing the stew
Poisonous potato is in the same consumable chest behind the brewing stand; player discovers it after brewing stand interaction reveals the nearby chest
Suspicious stew applies Hunger II effect that drains the hunger bar below 20, which is mechanically REQUIRED for eating poisonous_potato (a normal food needing non-full hunger)
Crafting slabs requires opening the material chest which also contains 6 pumpkins; player discovers pumpkins during slab crafting, then locates the nearby farmer villager to trade
